verdict.rationale: Turso documents official SDKs across TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go, with detailed quickstarts, authorization/JWKS guides, a serverless HTTP client for edge runtimes, and framework guides (e.g., Next.js), plus a Platform API for programmatic control — all clearly aimed at building AI-native apps/agents (agent-database and AI-memory guides). Community reports (turso-comm-1, turso-comm-2) confirm real-world usage of these SDKs successfully, though some users note SQLite compatibility gotchas (turso-comm-4, turso-comm-8, turso-comm-9) unrelated to SDK API quality itself. Missing for 10: deeper independent corroboration for the non-TS SDKs (Python/Rust/Go) and no resolution of the noted compatibility edge cases.
